data.title: A lysosome-to-nucleus signalling mechanism senses and regulates the lysosome via mTOR and TFEB
data.authors: Settembre C; Ballabio A et al.

evidence.label: Molecular — cells, biochemistry, structure
evidence.note: this describes the kind of study, not its quality

data.finding: A lysosome-to-nucleus mechanism uses mTOR-dependent TFEB phosphorylation to sense lysosomal state.
data.abstract_excerpt: The lysosome plays a key role in cellular homeostasis by controlling both cellular clearance and energy production to respond to environmental cues. However, the mechanisms mediating lysosomal adaptation are largely unknown. Here, we show that the Transcription Factor EB (TFEB), a master regulator of lysosomal biogenesis, colocalizes with master growth regulator mTOR complex 1 (mTORC1) on the lysosomal membrane. When nutrients are present, phosphorylation of TFEB by mTORC1 inhibits TFEB activity.

extracted_findings.effect: A lysosome-to-nucleus signalling mechanism via mTORC1-TFEB senses and regulates the lysosome
